company_name: NIPPON EXPRESS (SOUTH ASIA & OCEANIA) PTE. LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Express provides specialized logistics solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, optimizing supply chains from equipment delivery to finished product logistics.
summary: Nippon Express (South Asia & Oceania) Pte. Ltd. is a global logistics provider that specializes in semiconductor logistics solutions. They offer comprehensive services including the delivery and storage of capital equipment, wafers, semiconductor parts, and spare parts, along with end-to-end management and logistics operations within factories.
